title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit Rulebook — Earning Credit on Trips
content:
# Earning Pass ride credit on trips — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rules in force

**R1. Status.** Pass ride credit is earned only on trips completed while the membership is in trial, active or pending cancellation status. The status the membership record shows decides; the credit belongs to that membership.

**R2. Minimum fare.** A trip whose eligible fare is below the plan's minimum eligible fare earns nothing.

**R3. Posting.** Credit posts the plan's posting delay in hours after drop-off and can be spent from then on.

## Retired rules

> **Former R-a.** Only trips in a ride option listed among the plan's credit-earning ride options earned credit, reserved trips included; the eligible fare was the trip's fare charge less the ride option's booking fee, and wait time, tolls, airport fees, Priority Pickup, reservation fees and tips never counted.

> **Former R-b.** The credit was the plan's credit rate of the eligible fare, rounded half up to the cent, capped at the plan's per-trip cap and at what remained of the plan's monthly cap for the calendar month of the drop-off (the credit earned on the membership in that month, less credit of that month forfeited because its trip was refunded); when the monthly cap was reached the trip earned nothing and nothing carried over.

Former R-a and Former R-b are **no longer in force**. They have been superseded and are reproduced only as the earlier wording of this rulebook.

## Status table for R1

R1 is a complete list ("only"), so the table below covers every status.

| Membership status when the trip was completed | Earns Pass ride credit? |
|---|---|
| trial | yes |
| active | yes |
| pending cancellation | yes |
| enrolled | no |
| past due | no |
| paused | no |
| cancelled | no |

## Hypothetical cases

- A trip completed while the member had turned auto-renew off (pending cancellation) earns credit under R1.
- A trip completed while the membership was paused earns nothing under R1.
- A trip whose eligible fare is 4.99, under a minimum eligible fare of 5.00, earns nothing under R2; one at exactly 5.00 is not below the minimum.
- A trip dropped off at 18:00 on a Monday has its credit posted, and spendable, 48 hours later, at 18:00 on the Wednesday.
